comment: Very kind professor with lots of niche, interesting insight

Dr. French is one of my favorite professors I've had at Richmond. She has a lot of world experience and has a lot of advice to give to pre-law students. She says what she thinks and leads class discussion well.

Dr. French is really kind and if you participate, the class is definitely interesting. Lectures and readers were a bit boring at times, but she is a very gracious grader if you engage well with the readings in your essay.

Dr. French is amazing, and I could not recommend her more. I have taken two classes with her and do not regret it at all. She is super nice and just great to be around. Just be respectful, read before class, and you are going to succeed!

Professor French is one of my favorite professors by far. She cares about her students and the material that she is teaching. She ensures that everyone stays engaged in discussion while staying understanding of those who are more introverted.
Love her. So fun to be in her class. We learn a lot because she is so qualified and intelligent, while also laughing and making genuine connections with her and out classmates.

Dr. French is a very good, easy prof.. She often strays off topic during class discussions BUT usually finds a way to integrate tangent topics into the section's curriculum. I took her course as an undeclared (thinking I would major in anthro), but ended the course feeling a little underwhelmed by the subject (probably nothing to do with French).

What a great professor! She is very sweet and she is very helpful. I loved being in her class and I learned something new each and every class session. She listens and cares about her students. The work load is not too much and she makes you like what she is teaching. I would love to take another class with her !!
Loves what she does. Participate in class and you will be successful. When you comment, try relate to your own life.

I had Dr. French for two anthro classes and she made me fall in love with it so much I changed my major She is honestly by far my favorite professor at Richmond. She genuinely cares and loves the subject and will work with you anyway possible. Her class isnt super easy but it is not that hard, its all interesting and she obviously loves teaching it

She's harder than she used to be.  i think the school yelled at her or something, so don't believe people that tell you she's really easy.  my roommate made me fall for that trap and i got a C by working medium/hard.    she's cool though, and a good teacher.

Completely unclear on expectations and what she actually wanted from you in terms of content in work.  Assigned way too much reading in the textbook, especially for an intro level course.  The material and discussions were interesting, but don't take this class if you want an A.  She kept telling our class that we should be happy with C's!

She is genuinely interested in her students and talks to them more like peers.  She will listen to your opinion and then she will remember it later on in the year.  She will be accomodating with things like paper deadlines.  If you participate in class and read the books (at least somewhat) you will do fine.  Thumbs up!  Yay Professor French! :)

um this woman is AMAZING. she is so ADD, so funny and nice. i adore her. easy teaching style, very fair grading. flexible schedules and lets us have class outside. i highly recommend taking any class with her.

Jan is a great, relaxed professor. She is always asking us about Richmond and the students (it's her first year here). She cares about her students, and gives great lectures. The reading is easy, short, and not really mandatory. She is also willing to switch syllabus dates if there is a problem. I would definitely recommend this class to anyone.

Great professor coming from Duke. She is dedicated, fair, fun & is willing to swing off-topic occasionally by pulling articles from the Collegian or asking about the meaning of "popped collars." Definitely easy to get along with, loves her students & her subject. Also offers some extra credit opportunities & posts her Powerpoints online.
